set_version: llamaindex/ParseBench, the PDF pages under docs/ (chart, layout, table, text); the 42 JPG/PNG layout pages are left out
set_licence: Apache-2.0 (dataset card), over third-party documents it does not own

scorer.convention: survivor-only means from _evaluation_report.json aggregate_metrics (n_scored/n_total per metric)

not_measured.layout: ParseBench scores layout from boxes in its LayoutOutput; every column here hands it Markdown, so each would score nothing for a reason that is ours

conditions: DATASETS.toml [datasets.parsebench]: scores and file names only; every column's output stayed on the machine

pdfluent_balanced.name: PDFluent balanced
pdfluent_balanced.ocr: off: ocr="never"; the detector reads the rendered page for boxes, never for text

bench.because: SDK 1.2.0 release-candidate round 21-10: holdout check against the 17-10 round (owner decision 21-10)
